name: perfbee
description: Crawl your sites, read broken links, SEO and AI readiness issues with the HTML element each one sits in, and check whether a fix worked.

interface.longDescription:
PerfBee is a site crawler for SEO and web teams. This app lets ChatGPT crawl your sites and work with what PerfBee found.

What it can do:
- List your sites, with each site's latest crawl and its schedule.
- Start a crawl of a site, up to 500 pages. It runs in the background and you can ask for its status at any time. A site that is not in your account yet is added to your My Sites list.
- Read what a crawl found: broken links and resources with the page and the HTML element (XPath) they sit in, page SEO issues and AI readiness issues, each with a short fix.
- Get the fix list, most important first, and each fix's pages with the HTML element to change. A coding assistant can use this to find the fix in your site's code.
- Check whether a fix worked: PerfBee reads the fix's pages again.
- Search your site's page list: broken pages, redirects, noindex pages or pages with an SEO issue, by folder, and the pages that link to one URL.
- Check one page again right away after a change: its status, redirects, title and description, and whether it still links to a broken URL.
- Read the AI Search Readiness report and compare a crawl with the previous one.

Who it is for: SEO specialists, marketers and developers who look after a website.

Limitations:
- You need a PerfBee account.
- Crawls and fix checks use your PerfBee account's credits, the same as in the PerfBee dashboard. Reading results and checking a single page again do not.
- When you connect, you choose whether ChatGPT may start crawls or only read.
- It only reads websites. It never changes a website or its code.
- It cannot remove sites, change schedules or delete anything.
- It crawls public websites only, within your account's site limit.

Setup, limits and data use: https://perfbee.com/mcp
defaultPrompt: What should I fix first on my site?
Show the broken links of my latest crawl with the element to fix.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists perfbee.com with its latest crawl (status, pages checked, broken count) and the credits left on the account.

positive.description: Read the issues of the latest crawl
positive.prompt: Show the broken links and SEO issues of the latest crawl of perfbee.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the issues of the latest completed crawl, each with the page, the HTML element and a short fix, or says the crawl found none. Pages the site refused are reported as not checked, never as broken.

positive.prompt: What does the AI readiness report say about perfbee.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises which AI crawlers robots.txt allows and how many pages AI answers can quote, with the main page issues.

positive.prompt: What changed on perfbee.com since the previous crawl?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports new, gone and changed pages and new and fixed broken links between the latest two full crawls of perfbee.com.

Starts a crawl of at most 10 pages (or reports the crawl already running), says it runs in the background for a few minutes and gives the link to the report. Asked later, get_scan_status reports its result.

positive.description: Add a site and crawl it
positive.prompt: Add books.toscrape.com to my PerfBee sites and crawl it.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds https://books.toscrape.com to My Sites and starts its crawl in the background, says it takes a few minutes and gives the link to the report. books.toscrape.com is a public demo site made for crawler testing. When the site is already in My Sites, it starts a new crawl instead.

positive.prompt: What should I fix first on perfbee.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open fixes of perfbee.com, most important first, each with why it ranks there, what is wrong and how to fix it, or says the list is empty.

positive.prompt: Show me the pages and the HTML element of the first fix on perfbee.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pages of that fix, most linked first, with the CSS selector or XPath of the element and what the page has there today, or the pages that link to a broken URL.

positive.prompt: Check whether the first fix on perfbee.com is fixed now.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a check of a sample of that fix's pages and says how many pages it reads and the most it can cost, or explains why this fix is checked by the next full crawl instead.

positive.prompt: List the blog pages of perfbee.com with their status and SEO issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pages under perfbee.com/blog/ from the latest crawl, each with its status code, title and issues in words, and offers the next ones when there are more.

positive.prompt: Check the perfbee.com home page again right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks https://perfbee.com once and reports its status code, any redirects and its title, meta description and H1, without using credits.

negative.description: A website that is not public. PerfBee crawls public websites only; start_crawl refuses the address, no site is added and no crawl starts.
negative.prompt: Crawl my intranet at http://192.168.1.10 and list its broken links.

negative.description: Deleting data. PerfBee has no tool that deletes crawls or sites; the assistant should say it cannot do this and point to the PerfBee dashboard.
An unrelated request. Nothing about the user's sites or crawls; PerfBee tools should not be called.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to London next Friday.

review.commerce_description: PerfBee does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Crawls use credits of the user's existing PerfBee plan.

publication.release_notes: start_crawl now adds a site that is not in My Sites yet and says the crawl runs in the background. get_fixes returns each fix's id. New tools: get_fix_pages (a fix's pages and the HTML element to change), check_fix (reads a fix's pages again to see whether it worked), find_pages (searches the site's page list) and recheck_url (checks one URL again right now).
